summary: Iteration 7 - Per-size QR codes. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass covering auto has_qr-per-size on create, partial sizes=[M,L] generation, null-sizes=all, sizeless ignore sizes, qr-images response shape (payload=id#size, data_url data:image/png;base64,...), sizeless single entry, qr-filters.total per-size counting, qr-labels PDF 200, basic plan 403 on both qr endpoints, tenant isolation. Frontend: Login via /innlogging works, /app/utstyr renders inventory-page with gen-qr-{id} on every row (7 found) and view-qr-{id} on rows with active QR (4 found). GenerateQrDialog opens with gen-qr-all + gen-qr-size-{S/164/...} checkboxes for sized items and gen-qr-submit works end-to-end (row refreshed, view-qr count went 4->5). ViewQrDialog renders view-qr-grid with 2 PNG base64 images (data:image/png;base64, length 18986) + print-qr-btn. Sidebar Skann QR link + /app/skann start-scan-btn present.
action_items: Previous suggestion still open: split server.py (~2324 lines) into routers (qr, invoices, notifications).
qr-labels still synchronously renders all PNGs - consider background job for large tenants.
Login route is /innlogging but previous test reports documented /logg-inn. Confirm canonical route and update any seed docs/credentials file if needed (purely informational, auth works).
critical_code_review_comments: generate_item_qr uses set(data.sizes) when provided - good; when sizes is None it defaults to ALL sizes (expected). Behavior for empty list [] = 'no sizes selected' = no-op (silently sets has_qr=any() = still True if any had it). Verify this matches UI expectation (not tested but logically consistent).
qr-filters endpoint still returns full item list (up to 5000) to compute totals and groups - prefer $facet/$group aggregation.

Item PUT does not re-apply auto has_qr=True on size add (only create does). If an admin adds a new size to an existing clothing item on deluxe, that size won't auto-get has_qr - user must click Generer QR again. Likely intentional but worth confirming with product.
qr-images uses _build_qr_png_b64 and _load_club_logo once per call; good. For items with 10+ sizes this is still O(N) sync CPU work in request handler - OK for current scale.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all testids + end-to-end sized generation + view-qr-grid images verified)
